<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Upgrade installed packages to the versions available from configured
repositories.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `899900`     |
| Dependencies | `pkg-update` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Includes pkg-update and runs after package lists are refreshed. Repository
configuration determines the versions installed in the image.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/pkg-upgrade"]
```
